title: Compiler and Hardware Co-Design for Accelerator Architectures
summary: Heterogeneous accelerator architectures offer an efficient path to performance for compute-intensive workloads. However, full-stack integration remains difficult. We present EAAC (Extensible Accelerator Architecture), a flexible and extensible compiler and hardware architecture designed to lower the overhead of hardware-compiler co-development for rapid prototyping of hardware accelerators. displayTitle: EAAC：可扩展加速器的编译-硬件协同设计框架
narrative: 今日 arxiv cs.AR 上 EAAC（Extensible Accelerator Architecture）论文提出一种异构加速器架构 + 配套编译器的协同设计框架，重点解决 "full-stack integration 难" 这件事——硬件加速器性能再好，软件栈不完整也跑不出真实负载。论文给出一套硬件-软件协同方法，让新加速器从原型到 production 的时间显著缩短。对 NVIDIA 是中性——他们的软件栈仍是护城河；对 Tenstorrent / Cerebras / Groq / SambaNova / 国产 AI 芯片是直接利好——他们最缺的就是软件栈成熟度，EAAC 这种"框架级"工作会缩短他们的迭代周期；对 EDA 公司（Cadence / Synopsys）也是利好——加速器架构 + 协同设计工具链本来是 EDA 厂商要吃下的市场。这是一篇把"加速器门槛"削低的论文，长期看 AI 芯片创业生态会因此更繁荣。
